create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass instance with embed_dim, hidden_dim, num_heads, and attention_types for a Gemma model
build_attention_layer_pattern: build an attention layer type pattern by repeating a tuple of AttentionType values across a given number of layers
create_kv_cache_sharing: create a KV cache sharing pattern list from a KVCacheSharingConfig, num_layers, and attention types sequence
init_transformer_cache: initialize a new transformer KV cache dictionary with a given batch size, dtype, and cache length using TransformerConfig
compute_query_pre_attn_scalar: compute the query pre-attention normalization scalar value from a TransformerConfig using the configured QueryPreAttentionNormalisation strategy
